title: validacion-oe4: Internal validation of the recommendation engine

creators.name: Quintero-Avellaneda, Diego
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Administration, Universidad Nacional de Colombia (National University of Colombia), Manizales Campus

description: Price snapshots with SHA-256 checksums, evaluation scripts and results of the internal validation of the adaptive portfolio recommendation engine (owa-recommender): window-level suitability in three layers (target, attained ex ante, realised), Stage 2 range diagnostics, stress robustness, ranking quality and comparison with benchmarks in the United States and Colombia. Doctoral thesis of Diego Quintero-Avellaneda, Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Manizales Campus.
